headline: Manorama Industries board approves qualified institutional placement (QIP)
sum: Manorama Industries Limited's board of directors has approved a qualified institutional placement (QIP) through a board meeting held on 29 June 2026, signalling the company's intent to raise capital from institutional investors under SEBI's QIP framework.
detail: On 29 June 2026, Manorama Industries Limited's board of directors met and approved a qualified institutional placement. The NSE filing confirms board-level sign-off on the QIP structure, the first formal step toward potential institutional capital raise. No announcement of quantum, pricing, or timeline has been disclosed in the available filings. Subsequent steps will include SEBI LoA, shareholder ratification (if mandated), and placement execution.
